duress-verifier.meaning: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256(pin UTF-8, kdf-salt, 600000, 32) — SecureStore.setDuressPin; matchesDuressPin(candidate) = (PBKDF2(candidate, kdf-salt) == stored) checked BEFORE unlock; a match calls SecureStore.obliterate()

kdf-salt.meaning: PBKDF2 salt (the 'pepper'): random 32 B generated once per install, never stored in pyro.store. storeKey = PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256(password UTF-8, kdf-salt, 600000, 32)
